evals.name: Diagnose and split a 2,400-token AGENTS.md into L1/L2/L3 progressive disclosure
evals.prompt: Our root AGENTS.md consumes 2,400 tokens on every prompt turn. Audit the workspace token footprint and refactor it below 800 tokens without losing governance rules.

assertions.description: Agent executed the deterministic context footprint scanner script.
Agent applied progressive disclosure offloading to keep root instructions compact.

assertions.description: Ignore manifest excludes high-token lockfiles and compiled output directories.
